# Every row of the old workflow's own checklists, and where the lite workflow keeps it. Read by
# tests/workflow-power.test.sh. One row per line: <old row> :: <kept|merged> :: <file> :: <text>.
# The text is a fixed string the file must carry, matched with its line breaks and indentation
# folded into single spaces. A row may not be dropped here: a check the lite flow no longer runs
# is a loosening, which needs the user's words and a CHANGELOG line, not a quiet edit.
# the old law self-audit, nineteen rows
audit 1, every phase ticked with its exit, skips reasoned :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Phases ticked with their exit, skips reasoned
audit 2, every question through AskUserQuestion :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: questions only through AskUserQuestion
audit 3, every scout run, every row disposed :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: The scout run after every task, every row disposed
audit 4, an evidence row per task and per acceptance bullet :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: A fresh Evidence row per task and per Done-when check
audit 5, the three ship-gate rows :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: ship-gate rows present
audit 6, a coverage row per touched path, decision table empty :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: a row per touched path, every finding challenged and decided
audit 7, zero banned tokens, cap breaks, inline types :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Zero banned tokens, cap breaks or inline types in the touched scope
audit 8, every new file placed per 2.2 :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: files per 2.2
audit 9, no discarding git command, no AI attribution :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: No git command that discards work; explicit staging; no AI attribution
audit 10, every update-log claim has a proof row :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: the proof behind every claim
audit 11, agent availability recorded once :: merged :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: `Helpers: on | unavailable. Advisor: yes | no.`
audit 12, every agent result re-run before its tick :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Helper results re-run before their ticks
audit 13, own leftovers swept, nothing found fixed, reuse search shown :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Own leftovers swept, reuse searches shown
audit 14, a coverage map with no holes :: merged :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: None left open.
audit 14, the intent confirmed (Q0) :: merged :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: When the ask reads two ways, the first question confirms which
audit 15, every phase on its agent and model :: merged :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Three custom agents, each with its own model and turn cap
audit 16, the goal delivered, every other finding filed :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Nothing found on the way fixed; every follow-up filed with its file:line
audit 17, the six deploy proofs and the live verify :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Where anything deployed, the six proofs and the live check pasted
audit 18, files read whole, numbers counted :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: files read whole, numbers counted
audit 19, every advisor run point consulted :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: the advisor at plan, review, direction, done
# the old exit artifacts (5.1), one per phase
exit clarify, the goal restated and the repo read :: merged :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Restate the goal in one line: who it is for, what changes, what is left out
exit plan, the work-doc written and said in chat :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: the work-doc with Goal, Done when and Plan, said in chat in two lines
exit spec review, the plan checked before any code :: merged :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Then the advisor checks the plan.
exit implement, every task ticked, scouted and committed :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: every Plan box ticked with a fresh proof line, the scout clean or every row disposed, every task committed
exit debug, root cause, then regression test, then fix :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: confirm the root cause from evidence (10.1), then a regression test, then the fix
exit verify, proof per task and check, what was not reached :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: One Evidence line each, `command → result line`, and one line on what the checks did not reach
exit verify, the design pre-flight on UI work :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: on UI-bearing work the design pre-flight (15.30)
exit review, one review and one fix pass, re-verified :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: One review, one fix pass
exit land, the landing chosen by the user :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: when there is a choice (merge, a pull request, keep the branch), ask through `AskUserQuestion`
exit sweep, one line per class, zero included :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: one line each with its count, zero included
exit archive, status done then the move :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Write `status: done`, then at once `git mv` the work-doc into `docs/work/done/`
exit close, the self-audit and the release notes :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: print the self-audit below; any `no` reopens the phase that owns it

# the clarify round's coverage map (6.15) and the rest of the old ledger rules
coverage map, every aspect settled :: merged :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: each aspect the task touches
ledger, phases in order, none silently dropped :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: one open at a time, none silently dropped
ledger, a tick carries its reflection, the doc first :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: lands in the work-doc before the chat re-print; a deferred write is no tick
ledger, a notification per boundary :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: one `PushNotification` line under 200 characters
ledger, the check-in and the drift check :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: run the drift check
loop-back, a red or a finding reopens Implement :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: reopens Implement; run forward again with fresh evidence
waivers, never the caps, integrity, questions, git, Critical fix :: merged :: law/engineering-law.md :: Never waivable: the caps and bans, claim integrity, questions through `AskUserQuestion`, git safety, fixing a critical finding against this change.
waivers, never a blocking ship-gate leg or the review :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: a blocking ship-gate leg and the review are never waived
what never leaves the session :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: This session keeps the ledger and every tick
re-anchor after context loss :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: After context loss, re-read the law, the code rules, this skill and the in-flight work-doc
# the logic-first gate (law 1.4) and the two lanes, added with them
logic gate, the yes before any change :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: nothing is written or changed before the yes
logic gate, survives a skipped Plan :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: A skipped Plan still shows the logic
logic gate, the yes recorded :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: Logic confirmed: <the user's answer>
logic gate, a helper builds only confirmed logic :: kept :: agents/er-builder.md :: the logic in your brief is the one the user confirmed
lanes, fast only by the lane picker and the plan line :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: `lane: fast` with that line honestly true
lanes, the fast lane is still reviewed :: kept :: skills/workflow/SKILL.md :: fast lane or helpers unavailable, the same review here
review, one reproducing command per finding :: kept :: agents/er-reviewer.md :: each finding gets one command that shows it
